objective: server/services/documents/quality.ts (~L131) adds page.characterCount for every page, including pages distrusted for OCR confidence below the floor, and that total drives the minDocumentCharacters check. Four readable 45-character pages are BLOCKED; add a 3000-character page at confidence 0.1 and the document becomes READY_WITH_WARNINGS. CLAUDE.md §9: a page below ocrConfidenceFloor counts as unread. Fix: use characters from readable pages only for the minimum-document check, keeping any raw total that is reported elsewhere.
expectedOutcome: Unreadable pages never make a document auditable.
nonGoals: Changing the confidence floor or thresholds

acceptanceConditions.statement: a distrusted OCR page contributes nothing to the minimum-text check, with a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
